main_text.p: inter cætera quadraginta articulos ad ci-uilem & militarem politiam spectantes. Politicus & Historiographus Galli, qui ad eam diem Papistæ fuerant, ad Dominum conuersi, ab Ecclesia, cum mandatis in diuersa mittitur. Historiographus ad Principes & gentes vicinas, vt illis tragœdias Gallicas exponat, & officium ipsorum erga pios. Politicus ad oppressos Gallos, vt ipsis decretum & sententiam à Daniele latam, formam que administrationis ab ipso institutam significer.

page.notes: The faint text in the lower half is show-through from the reverse page and is left out. No page number, running head or catchword is printed on this page. The asterism below the text is a printed ornament and is given as a foot line.
